answer: Liability-backed vouching admits a new agent only when three established members co-sign for it and lock part of their own stake; if it is later caught as a sybil, every voucher is slashed. Each voucher can back few agents at once, so N fake heads need N fresh sets of real, staked sponsors who risk losing funds, and cost grows per head. Like an ember in dry cedar, one exposed fake burns its whole vouching chain for falcon-eyed auditors.
